problem: Own agent integration currently requires hand-building nested token execution JSON. A passive, portable capture must retain original provider bytes and explicit owner bindings without gaining signing/network powers or hiding malformed responses.
requirements: Standard-library CLI/API. No network code, signer, wallet, subprocess grader or new dependency. Accept only caller-supplied bytes/files.
Policy template must explicitly declare authority, network, token, payer, finite horizon, intents and receipt-to-intent bindings. No amount-based assignment or inferred owner consent.

Store exact original policy/request/response bytes and SHA-256 with safe generated paths. Never overwrite an existing output directory. Hash equality is internal integrity, not source authenticity or consensus.
Validate strict UTF-8/duplicate/integer JSON using current payment decoder before embedding records. Preserve all raw inputs, including non-JSON/duplicate-field replies.

Uninterpretable records stay explicitly listed. Only supported parsed observations enter the existing profile, with an explicitly forced open horizon and changed note; no fabricated RPC error, hidden removal or clean gate from incomplete capture.

Known spending excess in interpretable evidence may still yield gate1 despite unrelated unparsed replies; otherwise incomplete capture cannot yield gate0. Existing payment assessor and browser contract stay unchanged.
Rebuild task/evidence/bundle on check from original bytes. Detect changed original bytes even when JSON semantics is unchanged. Reject unsafe/reused paths and record identities.
Generated exact-byte bundle must work in the existing CLI/local/browser WebAssembly inspector with matching full reports and visible source/scope claims.
Invalid policy or an unsupported assembled profile remains a structured rejected assessment, with raw capture retained. Do not relabel it as a financial clean result.
Evidence count, individual and aggregate byte bounds remain finite. Existing capture directories or unrelated user files are never deleted by failure recovery.
plannedChecks: Canonical allowed payment capture and exact full-report parity, not just gate parity.
Same-price independent intents and permitted installments stay within declared limits.
Repeated payment breach remains a breach.
HTML/non-UTF8/duplicate-field raw responses survive on disk and cannot produce a clean gate.
Known breach plus unrelated bad raw response remains gate1 with explicitly open horizon and retained bad bytes.
Edited whitespace in an original source file fails integrity rather than inheriting the old exported bundle.
Existing output directory, path traversal, symlink and duplicate record labels rejected without overwriting user data.
Generated bundle actual browser imports match Python for gates0,1,2.
limits: Source-informed engineering controls, not new chain/model execution or independent blind financial accuracy. Do not modify the ongoing locked agent-interface study or the released product before full validation.
